summary: ComposeEmptyReport has the same inverted band-order bug
detail: In BandLayoutEngine.ComposeEmptyReport (around line 294-308), the sequence is StartNewPage() first (which emits PageHeader), then ReportHeader via EmitBand, then NoData band, then ReportFooter. This mirrors the bug in ComposeDataReport. Session 2's fix must be applied at a level that covers BOTH paths -- either by refactoring StartNewPage to emit PageHeader conditionally (not on first call of page 1), or by having both ComposeDataReport and ComposeEmptyReport call a shared 'start-first-page-with-report-header-first' helper.

summary: PdfExporter.Title and Author properties are unused (metadata not written to PDF)
detail: PdfExporter declares Title and Author properties but never passes them to the underlying DabblerPdf Document (no AddTitle/AddAuthor calls). Writing them to PDF metadata is orthogonal to the visible-title bug that this session set targets. The spec (Risk Notes and Goals) limits scope to visible page layout, and Session 2 Step 5 only mentions Title as 'fallback content title' gated by a new opt-in property -- not mandatory. Adding metadata writes is a 'fix while you're there' that should be done, but is not blocking for the UAT feedback that drove this set.
action: Optional: Session 2 may fold this in. If it does, the change should be purely additive (Title/Author written to PDF metadata) and MUST NOT affect visible layout. If not picked up, open a separate spec.
